messages:
rachel: deploy-bot stopped the canary for billing-collector in eu-west due to a values checksum mismatch during the 02:00 release window. can someone triage? :mag:

deploy-bot: preflight-failure: values.checksum != expected. canary paused. reason: eu overlay contains unapproved `workerConcurrency` increase + experimental flag. docs: https://ci.redwood/preflights/5642 :rotating_light:

tom: I pushed a harmless-looking bump to workerConcurrency (2 -> 5) to troubleshoot a local backlog, but forgot to gate it behind staging. it changed the hash.

rachel: rollback will push other services behind. product asked for low disruption. thoughts on pinning chart vs rollback?

oncall-sre: i'm oncall. if we pin, we should watch 5xx and processing lag for 20m. threshold: 5xx <= 0.3% and avg processing latency <= 220ms. if breached, execute rollback playbook.

maria-prod: product prefers pin if it keeps release moving. we can schedule the concurrency change into next deploy with feature gating.

tom: alternative: hotpatch values only on the overlay branch and re-run preflight, but that still touches the release flow. pin seems fastest.
rachel: agreed. pin plan: pin chart billing-collector to v3.4.2, re-run canary with monitoring window 20m. if canary fails, we'll call the rollback huddle. I'll author a short release-note line.
tom: running pin now: ```deploy-bot pin-chart billing-collector --chart-version=3.4.2 --reason="accidental eu overlay workerConcurrency bump" --actor=tom```
deploy-bot: pinned billing-collector chart=3.4.2 by tom; canary retry initiated (id=57702). monitoring targets set. will post updates.
oncall-sre: 5m check 12: p95 processing latency 110ms, 5xx 0.01%. no regressions. continuing 20m watch.

deploy-bot: canary promoted at 18m. metrics: avg latency 105ms, 5xx 0.02%. promoting release.
rachel: release notes blurb posted: "chart pinned to v3.4.2 to avoid accidental overlay change; concurrency bump deferred." pinged product.
tom: added post-merge comment on PR reminding to target staging overlays and added a tiny CI check to flag overlay changes.
maria-prod: thanks team. closing thread and filing a short incident note for process follow-up. :white_check_mark:
